task.description:
Implement SPT-02 data migration. Run codegen for each migration YAML, then implement the custom blocks:

migrations/061_spt02_copy_rows_to_tenant_schemas.sql:
  - For each distinct tenant_id in process_definitions (or any affected table), call bpm_provision_tenant_schema() to create tenant schema if not registered.
  - For each tenant, in a transaction: INSERT INTO tenant_<uuid>.process_definitions SELECT ... FROM public.process_definitions WHERE tenant_id = <tid>; repeat for ALL affected tables (process_instances, events, tasks, timers, audit_log, tenant_hostnames, tokens, sessions).
  - Skip tenants whose tenant_schemas.status is already 'active' (idempotency via tenant_schemas registry).
  - Mark tenant_schemas.status = 'active' after all tables are copied.

migrations/062_spt02_drop_tenant_id_columns.sql:
  - DROP COLUMN tenant_id from all affected tables in public.
  - DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS bpm_effective_tenant_id().
  - DROP POLICY ... on all public tables (all known RLS policies).
  - DROP INDEX IF EXISTS on all tenant-based composite indexes.

migrations/063_spt02_idempotency_belt_suspenders.sql:
  - DROP POLICY IF EXISTS for every previously known policy name on every affected table (belt-and-suspenders).

After writing migrations:
- Run: zig build migrate
- Run: zig build test
- Run: zig build (error-set check)
- All must exit 0.
- Commit to feature/WF02-spt-02 and push.
acceptance_criteria: migrations/062_spt02_drop_tenant_id_columns.sql exists and removes all tenant_id cols and RLS
zig build exits 0 with no error-set output
